search_boundary: Public evidence available on 13 October 2026; not late-October or exhaustive novelty coverage.
method: Trace mechanisms to Git docs; source-pinned implementation comparisons; public issue-to-workflow countercases; backward/forward paper and repository leads; falsifying local fixtures.

sources.title: Git: git-commit
sources.used_for: Pathspec selection is file-scoped, not an A-only hunk selector; unrelated indexed paths are not automatically included.
sources.does_not_establish: Local fixture results apply to the recorded Git version, not every porcelain option or wrapper.

sources.title: Git: git-update-ref
sources.used_for: Conditional reference updates and native prepare/commit protocol are pre-existing Git mechanisms.
sources.does_not_establish: Documentation is not an execution proof for every Git backend or crash boundary.

sources.title: Git: git-commit-tree
sources.used_for: Creating a commit from a tree is existing plumbing and does not establish project correctness.
sources.does_not_establish: No validation of One Checkout follows merely from using this command.

sources.title: Git: environment variables
sources.used_for: GIT_INDEX_FILE and object-store controls underlie private-index workflows.
sources.does_not_establish: Private indexes alone do not provide complete concurrent landing or recovery.

sources.title: Git: racy-git
sources.used_for: Index-file timestamps participate in racy-clean stat-cache protection. Supports investigation of the locally reproduced copy/publication defect.
sources.does_not_establish: The actual One Checkout defect and fix are established by the included before/after fixtures, not by this document alone.

sources.title: Git: git-diff
sources.used_for: An explicit old-parent cached diff and a default HEAD-relative cached diff answer different questions.
sources.does_not_establish: A correctly based diff does not establish authorship or candidate correctness.

sources.title: Agentlocks: wrapped commit helper
sources.used_for: Inspected advisory resource/index leases, lease refresh and git add/commit with selected paths.
sources.does_not_establish: No explicit patch/expected-parent interface observed in this helper. Agentlocks was not executed; do not generalise absence to every interface.

sources.title: Worktrunk: parallel worktree workflow
sources.licence_observed: MIT OR Apache-2.0, inspected pinned LICENSE
sources.used_for: Separate working trees, create/start/merge/remove workflow and documented cache reuse are substantive alternatives.
sources.does_not_establish: Docs and pinned commit/licence inspected; Worktrunk was not installed, timed or compared end to end.

sources.title: Foremerge: JSON API, validation and acceptance
sources.used_for: ChangeSet fingerprints, trusted named checks and immutable validation attempts distinguish agent claims from current authoritative evidence.
sources.does_not_establish: Protocol documentation and source excerpts inspected, not an independent execution or security audit.

sources.title: Foremerge: benchmark plan
sources.used_for: Independent-work controls and distinction between deterministic correctness fixtures and productivity evaluation informed our comparison.
sources.does_not_establish: A proposed benchmark design is not measured comparative productivity.

sources.title: GitButler: parallel agents
sources.used_for: Documented shared workspace and per-task branch routing make GitButler close prior art.
sources.does_not_establish: Living documentation observed on the access date. It does not establish byte/entry equivalence to One Checkout, nor independent working-file isolation.

sources.title: GitButler: but commit
sources.used_for: CHANGES can select files or hunks, so selected-hunk commits are not a novel product category here.
sources.does_not_establish: No executable GitButler comparison was run. Default all-changes behaviour is not the only supported selection mode.

sources.title: GitButler: pinned commit tests and licence
sources.used_for: Inspected test source includes single-branch operation without the managed workspace ref; root licence inspected separately. Do not assume every use requires a workspace migration.
sources.does_not_establish: Only bounded source excerpts inspected, not the complete implementation or a run. No implementation code copied. Root licence is not a review of every separately licensed component.

sources.title: Jiang, Kim, Lin and Yang: Runnable Commit Untangling for Coding Agents
sources.used_for: RucTangle/TangleEval connects commit grouping and ordering to intermediate runnability and repair evaluation.
sources.does_not_establish: Preprint, not reproduced here. Its runnability check uses pytest collection, which is weaker than a full functional test suite.

sources.title: Muku: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner
sources.used_for: Merged-result evaluation, scope/producer-consumer scheduling and explicitly reported negative controls are useful design leads.
sources.does_not_establish: Preprint, not reproduced here. Declared scopes are seeded; live intervention combines timing, specificity, scopes and merge order. It does not isolate scheduling or establish automatic scope inference.

sources.title: Yan et al.: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
sources.used_for: Skill substitution can lose exclusive constraints despite task completion; motivates actual-path/runtime and invariant checks.
sources.does_not_establish: Preprint, not reproduced here. Its population and model-specific rates are not One Checkout or universal host failure rates.

sources.title: CooperBench: Why Coding Agents Cannot be Your Teammates Yet
sources.used_for: Evaluate cooperation and joint final success, not only individual agent completion or conflict counts.
sources.does_not_establish: Not reproduced; results do not directly measure One Checkout or shared-index contamination.

sources.title: AgenticFlict: A Large-Scale Dataset of Merge Conflicts in AI Coding Agent Pull Requests on GitHub
sources.used_for: Lead for a replay corpus of textual integration conflicts.
sources.does_not_establish: No dataset downloaded or licence clearance performed. Merge-conflict rates are not same-file staging contamination prevalence.

sources.title: Paperclip issue 9460: shared working directory and staged-file contamination
sources.used_for: A concrete public report of cross-run commit contamination and branch races, with a request for per-run worktrees.
sources.does_not_establish: One unreplicated report, not prevalence, purchase intent or evidence that this reporter prefers shared checkouts.

sources.title: Anthropic: Redesigning source control
sources.used_for: Scion motivates agent-scale source-control engineering; storage/history architecture differs from this local Git transaction.
sources.does_not_establish: No Scion source was executed or compared. Does not support equivalence, superiority, lab interest or a public installation claim.

sources.title: OpenAI: Build skills
sources.used_for: Official local skill locations and duplicate-name behaviour support real-discovery tests rather than filesystem-copy claims.
sources.does_not_establish: Living documentation, not an executed Claude/Codex host session.

sources.title: Anthropic: Claude Code skills
sources.used_for: Official skill packaging/discovery reference for the existing Claude route.
sources.does_not_establish: Living documentation, not an executed host or plugin validation in this review.

assimilation_note: Dated Type B research ledger retained as attributed candidate research. Specific mechanisms independently checked during integration; comparator performance and licence equivalence are not inferred. No third-party implementation vendored.
